name: Stoneclad Smokeshow Chicken
sub: Smoky chicken tenderloins with root vegetables and a lightly thickened savory broth. Yum!
text:
INGREDIENTS
1 3/4 lb chicken tenderloins, cut into bite-size pieces
10 oz red potatoes, cut into chunks
1 lb sweet potato, cut into chunks
6 oz carrots, chopped
8 oz celery, chopped
6 1/2 oz onion, chopped
2 tsp olive oil
1 cup prepared chicken bouillon
1 tsp unflavored powdered gelatin
1-2 Tbsp cold water, for blooming
Worcestershire sauce, to taste
1-2 Tbsp apple cider vinegar, for marinating the chicken
Smoked paprika, to taste
Garlic powder, to taste
Smoked salt, to taste
Black pepper, to taste
Onion powder, to taste
Thyme, to taste

DIRECTIONS
1. Heat the oven to 400 F.
2. Cut the red potatoes, sweet potato, carrots, celery, and onion into reasonably uniform pieces.
3. Toss the vegetables with the olive oil. Season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, smoked salt, black pepper, and thyme to taste.
4. Arrange the vegetables in a large stoneware baking pan and roast uncovered for about 20-25 minutes, giving the denser vegetables a head start.
5. Cut the chicken tenderloins into bite-size pieces. Season with Worcestershire sauce, smoked paprika, garlic powder, smoked salt, black pepper, onion powder, and thyme. Add 1–2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar and marinate for 20–30 minutes. Heat about 1 tablespoon avocado oil in a skillet over high heat. Do not crowd the pan; work in batches if needed. Cook for about 5–7 minutes, stirring frequently, until the chicken is fully cooked and browned. Keep the chicken separate while the vegetables finish, then spoon the moist, fall-apart tender chicken over the finished vegetables just before serving.
6. Add the prepared chicken bouillon and Worcestershire sauce.
7. Return the vegetable pan to the oven and continue cooking until the vegetables are tender. Keep the fully cooked chicken separate while the vegetables finish.
8. While the chicken finishes cooking, sprinkle the gelatin over 1-2 tablespoons cold water and allow it to bloom.
9. Stir the bloomed gelatin into the hot cooking liquid until dissolved, allowing the broth to become lightly thickened.
10. Let the finished dish rest briefly before serving.

NOTES
The ingredient amounts are flexible. Adjust the chicken, vegetables, seasonings, and proportions to suit your taste, the number of people you are feeding, and what you have on hand. This recipe is intended as a framework rather than a rigid formula.

Seasonings are intentionally listed to taste.

NUTRITION
Estimated whole batch: 1,872 calories · 200.1 g protein · 180.9 g carbohydrates · 35.9 g fat · 30.0 g fiber · 1,968 mg sodium.

Per serving, based on 6 servings: 312 calories · 33.4 g protein · 30.1 g carbohydrates · 6.0 g fat · 5.0 g fiber · 328 mg sodium.

Nutrition is estimated from the listed ingredient amounts. Changes to the chicken, vegetables, oil, bouillon, Worcestershire sauce, marinade, seasonings, or serving yield will change the macros and sodium.
